About Us

Your Local Auto Locksmith, On Call Day And Night

We are Beyond Entry Auto Vehicles, a local, family-run mobile car locksmith based in Keynsham and covering Bristol. Whether you are locked out, need a spare or have lost every key, we bring the workshop to your driveway and sort it there and then.

No main-dealer prices and no long waits. We come to you across Keynsham and Bristol, and most jobs are done the same day.
